views.rear: Opposite view confirms there are no deep grid gaps between the checker squares.
views.detail: Full detail shows contiguous checks and small separated yarn fringes; the original backing remains comparatively thick.
views.underside: The closed backing is retained and all fringe groups stay attached along the two edges.
